title.original: An Empirical Study of Automating Agent Evaluation
title.zh: 智能体评估自动化的实证研究
title.en: An Empirical Study of Automating Agent Evaluation

inclusion_reason.zh: EvalAgent 将评测知识封装为可组合 Skills，并自动生成、执行和 meta-evaluate 完整工件，属于评测工程自动化基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: EvalAgent packages evaluation expertise as composable skills and generates, executes, and meta-evaluates complete artifacts as evaluation-engineering automation.

abstract.zh: EvalAgent 把 Agent 评测知识封装为可组合 Skills，自动生成从轨迹指标、可执行代码到报告的端到端评测工件，并以 meta-evaluation 检查质量。
abstract.en: EvalAgent packages agent-evaluation expertise as composable skills that generate trace metrics, executable code, and reports, with meta-evaluation of the resulting artifacts.

problem.zh: 通用编程助手虽会写代码，却不了解 Agent 评测的指标选择、轨迹语义和 API 细节，容易生成过度复杂且无法执行的方案。
problem.en: General coding assistants can write code but lack agent-evaluation knowledge about metric choice, trace semantics, and APIs, producing over-engineered and non-executable evaluations.

approach.zh: 系统动态检索 API 文档，并组合程序说明、复用代码和模板化评测 Skills，沿轨迹管线生成并执行完整评测。
approach.en: The system retrieves API documentation and composes procedural instructions, reusable code, and templates into a trace-based generation-and-execution pipeline.

system_design.zh: EvalAgent 包含需求解析、Skill 检索/编排、指标设计、代码生成执行、报告器及 AgentEvalBench 驱动的 meta-evaluator。
system_design.en: EvalAgent includes requirement parsing, skill retrieval and orchestration, metric design, code generation/execution, reporting, and an AgentEvalBench meta-evaluator.

key_results.zh: 简单提示的编程助手执行成功率低且指标冗余；加入评测 Skills 后，首次可执行且有意义的评测比例和专家偏好均显著提升。
key_results.en: Prompted coding assistants execute poorly and overproduce metrics; evaluation skills substantially improve first-run meaningful execution and human expert preference.

limitations.zh: 基准只含有限 Agent 与需求，meta-evaluation 本身可能偏好预设范式；新领域仍需维护 Skills、模板和最新 API 文档。
limitations.en: The benchmark covers limited agents and requirements, meta-evaluation may favor predefined patterns, and new domains still require maintained skills, templates, and current API documentation.

baselines: Frontier coding assistants without evaluation skills

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
